title: No Pod activation possible since Android 16 Update
symptom: After updating a Pixel phone to Android 16, deactivating an old Omnipod DASH pod works, but activating a new pod fails with 'Failed to connect to pod'. Manual bonding mode also does not work, while an already-active pod continues to work.
cause: The Android 16 update exposes a compatibility bug in AAPS's DASH connection code that prevents activation of new pods, requiring a code hotfix.
fix: Update to AAPS 3.3.2.1 (which contains the fix), or build the dev332 branch; alternatively apply the hotfix-a16-dash commits 6153bc4 and 39dd2e6 to master. A temporary workaround is to activate the pod on a backup phone and import the settings export into the main phone.
evidence_quote: Fix for android 16 is merged to master in 3.3.2.1 - based on multiple reports from A16 users I believe this issue can be closed @MilosKozak
